title: Cenk Uygur SHUTS DOWN the Pro-War Panel's Iran Pitch in 60 Seconds
description:
In this video, we break down one of the most explosive foreign policy debates on Piers Morgan Uncensored, where Cenk Uygur passionately challenges calls for U.S. military intervention in Iran. What begins as a discussion about Iranian protests quickly turns into a fierce clash over regime change, the Iraq War, American foreign policy, Israel, and whether history is repeating itself.

Cenk argues that the push for military intervention follows the exact same script used before the Iraq invasion—promises of quick victory, claims that Americans will be welcomed as liberators, and assurances that no long-term occupation will be necessary. Drawing on decades of U.S. involvement in the Middle East, he warns that intervention would likely strengthen the Iranian regime, undermine legitimate protesters, and drag America into another costly and prolonged conflict.

The debate also features Piers Morgan, Chuck Todd, Rob O'Neill, and Iranian-born commentator Goldie, each offering sharply different perspectives on the current crisis. While some panelists argue that Iran's leadership has become increasingly isolated and that the protests represent a genuine opportunity for change, others caution that outside military involvement could produce devastating unintended consequences.

Throughout the discussion, major geopolitical questions take center stage:

• Should the United States intervene militarily in Iran?
• Can regime change ever succeed through foreign intervention?
